A local-only CLI plant-specimen accession pipeline. Takes messy fixture files (CSV/JSONL), normalizes into deterministic accession records, writes append-only logs, recovers safely from crashes. No network, no external dependencies, stdlib-only. Built to prove a workable accession workflow before any integration with larger systems.
